caption: The drawing depicts a bottle shaped like a standing human figure with a crown-like top, rendered in shades of brown and tan. The figure is dressed in what appears to be a skirt and a fitted top, with arms crossed across the chest. The bottle has sculptural details, such as facial features, folds in the clothing, and shoes. Attached to the left side of the figure’s skirt is an oval feature, resembling a shield or medallion, which includes text inscribed on it. The base is circular and the entire object has a glossy, reflective surface appearance, suggesting it is made of glass or ceramic. The background is plain and light-colored, and there are some small, printed labels at the bottom and to the right of the bottle.
title: Indian Maiden Bitters Bottle
